description: List a site's redirect rules in the order they are checked; the first match answers. User rules come first: `managedBy: "user"`, each with an `id`, kept on the hostname and changed with the redirect tools. Then the live deploy's `_redirects` rules: `managedBy: "file"`, each with its `line`, changed only by deploying a new `_redirects`. A file rule with `shadowedBy` never answers, because a user rule for the same path comes first. Returns `version`, which `set_redirects` and `edit_redirects` take to refuse a change if the rules changed since; `total` and a page of at most 1,000 rules from `offset`; the file's report, with the lines it skipped and why, and whether it is `enabled`; and the limits. Redirects apply only on the organization's own custom domains: on a shared domain the report says `notApplied: "CUSTOM_DOMAIN_REQUIRED"`.

limit.description: Rules to return, at most and by default 1,000.

offset.description: Position of the first rule to return, from 0. Defaults to 0.

partition.description: Data partition the site lives in. Omit to use the user's home partition.

name: list_redirects
